These terms apply to all users of SD Academy (sdacademy.co.in).

1. About SD Academy

SD Academy is an internal employee learning platform operated by the SD Group of Companies. Access is restricted to authorised SD Group employees, interns, trainees and approved administrators. It is not a public platform.

2. Eligibility and Account Access

  • Accounts are created exclusively by HR or authorised L&D administrators. Self-registration is not permitted.
  • Access is granted based on your employment status, entity, department and role within the SD Group.
  • Account access is updated or suspended automatically when your employment status changes.
  • You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your login credentials. Do not share your password with anyone.
  • If you suspect unauthorised use of your account, notify support@sdacademy.co.in immediately.

3. Authorised Use

SD Academy may be used only for:

  • Accessing and completing assigned learning modules and assessments
  • Reviewing approved SOPs, policies and checklists relevant to your role
  • Tracking your learning progress and certificates
  • Submitting support requests
  • Any other use expressly approved by your HR or L&D team

4. Acceptable Use Policy

You must not:

  • Upload, share or transmit any content that is defamatory, offensive, discriminatory or in violation of SD Group policies
  • Attempt to interfere with the security, integrity or availability of the platform
  • Use SD Academy for any personal commercial purpose

Violation of the Acceptable Use Policy may result in account suspension and disciplinary action in accordance with your employment agreement.

5. Mandatory Courses

Certain courses on SD Academy are designated as mandatory and have due dates. Failure to complete mandatory courses by the specified date may be treated as a conduct or compliance issue and reported to your manager and HR team.
